label: owner of
definition: The first person or organization owns or owned the second property, company, network or team.
scope_notes: Owner/own and corporate parent paths dominate in the owner-to-property direction, matching the earlier ownership scope. Historical ownership counts. Merger, rejected acquisition, chairmanship of an owner, publishing or a bare possessive alone does not establish ownership.
